members.label: Wasp Deluxe
members.differences: Behringer's copy of the Wasp in a desktop and Eurorack case, without the touch keyboard or the speaker, and in stereo. Most of its controls are the original's. Its filter adds a notch mode to the Wasp's three, the filter envelope gains a delay, the VCA a hold switch and the sustain knob a repeat position, and both oscillators gain an Enhance waveform from EDP's Gnat. MIDI In and Thru replace the original's 7-pin link sockets, with USB, patch points and a 16-voice poly chain.

members.label: EDP Wasp
members.differences: The original, EDP's 1978 monosynth: digital oscillators and a CMOS filter in a yellow and black plastic case, played from a flat touch keyboard through its own speaker, and linked to other units through two 7-pin sockets.
